purpose: prospectively test observer-boundary self-localization without pre-centering source bands and without the near-zero-residual normalization that invalidated R189
candidate_band_midpoints: absolute grid 0.60,0.62,...,0.96, independent of observer cutoff
source_pair_for_midpoint: C2 smooth cumulative source centers midpoint-0.03 and midpoint+0.03, halfwidth 0.02
scan_stage: use only the full constitutive tangent. Project away each observer's independently recomputed three-column interface tangent span. A candidate is scan-eligible when inner and band orthogonal norms are each at least 10% of the full-tangent orthogonal norm, the band/interior angle exceeds 150 degrees, and adding the band reduces the interior orthogonal norm by at least 50%. Select the eligible candidate with the largest reduction.
winner_mechanics_gate: only at the automatically selected winner, direct/state added-band angle >160 degrees; direct/state orthogonal-norm ratio in [0.75,1.33]; full-band orthogonal norm <=0.35*max(direct,state); decomposition closure normalized by max(direct,state) <1e-5
numerical_validity: all centered finite-difference step-angle checks used in scan and winner decomposition <0.01 degrees; baseline equilibrium residual infinity norms <1e-7
verdict_rule: all three unseen cutoffs pass localization, winner mechanics and numerical validity -> PROSPECTIVE_OBSERVER_SELF_LOCALIZATION_SUPPORTED
claim_boundary: A pass supports the observer-organized mechanism in this tested finite-BVP family and closes the R189 construction objection; it is not a continuum theorem.
